_doc: Candidate neighborhoods. Rent figures are ILLUSTRATIVE one-bedroom ranges for the demo; the skill researches live listings for real use.

candidates.name: Chelsea
candidates.vibe: Walk to work, High Line and the river on your doorstep, galleries on Thursdays.

candidates.name: Gramercy / Kips Bay
candidates.vibe: Quiet residential blocks, ten minutes on foot to Flatiron, farther from the river.

candidates.name: Boerum Hill, Brooklyn
candidates.vibe: Brownstone streets and more space for the money, with a subway ride to work.
